description: This file defines the interface for interacting with UCI (Unified Configuration Interface) in a specific software project. It includes macros and function declarations for initializing, freeing, and manipulating UCI configuration data and sections, tailored for the BBFDM context. The file appears to be a header defining API functions and macros for UCI management.

methods.name: bbfdm_init_uci_ctx
methods.description: Initializes the UCI context within the BBFDM context structure, preparing it for configuration operations.

methods.name: bbfdm_free_uci_ctx
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the UCI context in the BBFDM context structure.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_get_buf
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI option value as a string into a provided buffer, given package, section, and option names, with a default fallback.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_get
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI option value as a dynamically allocated string, given package, section, and option names.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_get_fallback_def
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI option value as a string, with a fallback default, given package, section, and option names.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_get_by_section_buf
methods.description: Fetches a UCI option value into a buffer from a specific section, with a default fallback.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_get_by_section
methods.description: Fetches a UCI option value as a string from a specific section.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_set
methods.description: Sets the value of a specific UCI option within a package and section.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_add
methods.description: Creates a new section of a specified type within a UCI package.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific option or entire section from a UCI package.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_delete_section
methods.description: Deletes a specific section from a UCI package.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_commit_package
methods.description: Commits (saves) all changes made to a specific UCI package.

methods.name: bbfdm_uci_walk_section
methods.description: Iterates over sections of a specific type within a package, returning the next section.
